decisions.reason: The Page 19 photo deletion does not change the background treatment required for the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, or last page.
The source changes which photo appears on Page 19, not the independently specified tree visibility in the Page 15 photo.
Removing or replacing one Page 19 photo does not alter the document-wide layout, formatting, coverage, or graphic-treatment strategy.
The Page 19 photo instruction does not change the Agua Arc brand identity, colors, or logo source.
The source concerns photo selection and does not change any typeface, font-size, or bold-formatting requirement.
Deleting or substituting a Page 19 image does not change required narrative sections or resolve the Section 6 content ambiguity.
The photo revision does not change Canva ownership, editability, asset restrictions, or source-deliverable requirements.
The Page 19 photo instruction has no effect on the inclusion or replacement of proposal tables.
The source addresses a Page 19 photo and does not change the one-page letter or Canva signature-insertion behavior.
Changing a photo on Page 19 does not reorder or otherwise alter the fixed RFQ section sequence.
Allowing one rather than two pictures on Page 19 does not explicitly change the document page-count target or layout-compaction rule.
The Page 19 photo change does not affect the requirement that proposal hyperlinks remain functional.
